consent.note: User-choice storage remains for opt-out; Cloudflare resolver sets required:false for owner-authorized default display trial. Other hosts retain legacy consent gates.

note: Cloudflare-only Adsterra ads are configured for automatic display by publisher request without homepage permission prompts. Users can opt out in footer, saved denials and GPC take precedence. Netlify/Render off. Regional consent compliance requires review.

cloudflareAdsterra.note: Cloudflare-only publisher-authorized default display trial. Third-party ads can process cookies and device data; GPC and saved opt-out are honored. Applicable consent-law review/CMP still required before broad deployment to regulated markets.

layoutNote: Cloudflare Pages: ONE original direct Adsterra Native Banner tag only; custom iframe banner placements OFF per Adsterra support warning. Original banner keys retained for reference, not loaded. No verified video-only unit. Existing GPC/opt-out and regional consent obligations remain.

cloudflareBanners.source: All three banner scripts supplied in full by owner on October 31, 2026.
cloudflareBanners.verificationNote: All three full banner code snippets exactly match the configured keys, dimensions and external script URLs; this proves only code correctness, not actual ad fill or acceptable creative categories.
cloudflareBanners.disabledReason: Adsterra support says publisher-side iframes embedding ad codes are forbidden and can cause suspension; this preserves unit records but blocks all custom iframe ads while awaiting direct approved replacement.
